138.description: Delicate denizen of Azuremyst Isle, this magical insect has been rumored to possess healing abilities.

140.description: Prefers flying during thunderstorms, which are common in Azuremyst Isle.

141.description: Prefers flying during foggy nights, which are common in Azuremyst Isle.

142.description: Once prized by dragonhawk breeders in Silvermoon. Stands out at night to predators, making it necessary to gain awareness at an early age.

143.description: Mortal enemies with silver dragonhawks; on pretty good terms with golden dragonhawks.

144.description: Ferocious species of dragonhawk, often seen diving down on prey from high in the sky.

145.description: Raised by the few dealers still willing to trade in Netherstorm.

149.description: The magical energies released during Skywing's transformation back into his true arakkoa form liberated this poor creature, a fledgling bird imprisoned by Luanga in order to power his fowl curse.

153.description: Many a drunken Brewfest goer has told the tale of this mysterious creature, but few remember that tale in the morning.

156.description: Although loath to part with Bananas, Landro realized it would be safer if the pet was far from Booty Bay when his father, King Mukla, discovered he was missing.

157.description: He's slightly evil but extremely narcoleptic. Keep him away from critters!

160.description: Stinker uses his aroma to repel predators and attract cats. He's much more successful with the former than the latter.

158.description: The sin'dorei use hawkstriders as mounts, but this little one was deemed unfit after being diagnosed with numerous anxiety disorders.

159.description: Domesticated elekks are trained as mounts by the draenei people. In the wild they are hunted for their ivory tusks.

162.description: This mischievous gourd likes to pop out of the ground and scare you right out of your pants. Hail to the pumpkin song!

173.description: Crocolisks are six-legged amphibian predators found in coastal waters. Archaeologists believe they may be descended from the diemetradons of Un'Goro Crater.

179.description: These stunning creatures, awarded to heroes for victory in battle, represent bravery and strength.

190.description: When it senses the impending death of a nearby creature, the skull will emit an ear-piercing cackle.

191.description: This mechanical warrior is a favorite gift during Winter Veil. Batteries not included, but rockets definitely are!

192.description: Mr. Chilly's appearance evokes a more civilized era, when duelists battled in tuxedos.

194.description: Unlike most of Geen the gorloc's 'mysterious eggs,' this one actually contained a living thing.

195.description: The rare albino tickbird is revered amongst the Oracles. It is seen as a sign of heavy rainstorms, good grub harvests, and hibernating wolvar.

196.description: These voracious whelps grow at an incredible rate and can devour nearly twice their weight in raw meat per day.

197.description: The cobras of Azeroth are renowned for their fast-acting venom and swift strikes.

198.description: Notable for its wide eyes and sassy slide.

202.description: This rare bear is bred for its small size and perpetually youthful appearance.

209.description: Unlike the polymorphed variety, trueborn sheep can be quite scary.

203.description: She likes the company of friends. Seventy-five of them, to be precise.

216.description: These young orcs strive to embody the Argent Crusade's virtues: valor, strength, and integrity.

214.description: Many of Stormwind's youth joined the Argent Crusade as squires, hoping to one day serve the Holy Light in battle.

224.description: Many have mocked this cat before battle. Their last words are usually, 'Here, kitty, kitty.'

225.description: The bouncy gurloc is a distant cousin of the murloc.

226.description: Despite their smaller stature, the wolvar are some of the most aggressive creatures in Northrend. This often makes their curious nature intimidating.

227.description: A fighting robot fueled by delicious red or blue electrolytes.

229.description: This extremely rare species of mana wyrm is prized for its unique coloration and even temperament.

236.description: This hatchling is coveted for its unique coloration. Despite Breanni's loving care, the raptor's feral nature cannot be restrained.

243.description: Spawn of Onyxia, this young dragon has decided that it doesn't want to follow in its grandfathers' cataclysmic footsteps.

244.description: Found in the Firelands and the Molten Core, core hounds can trace their lineage back to the alpha male, Magmadar.

250.description: Although small, pugs are very dangerous when provoked.

254.description: Jepetto's top-selling toy this season, the bot's new blue chassis has children across Azeroth scrambling for this feisty battle bot.

255.description: Breanni in Dalaran, one of the world's foremost collectors of exotic pets, will only award the mystical Celestial Dragon to fellow collectors whose obsession rivals her own.

270.description: Fire hatchlings are born from the ashes of a phoenix. Dark hatchlings emerge from their shadows.

272.description: Rolls into a protective ball when it feels threatened. Or when its mother calls.

280.description: Guild pages must be fearless since they are called upon to announce their guild's victories over the Horde in battle.

282.description: When guilds have accumulated enough wealth, brave soldiers are often called to bear their standards.

310.description: Voodoo figurines were often empowered by flasks of mojo, troll sweat, and the flesh of tribal enemies.

316.description: Not yet the fearsome creatures they grow to in adulthood, the Cenarion hatchlings have an almost harmless appearance that has caught novice trainers of the Cenarion Circle off guard.

320.description: A legendary member of the blue dragonflight.

323.description: Most squirrels hoard acorns for sustenance. Nuts, on the other hand, hoards acorns to stock its supply of ammunition.

325.description: One of the rarest creatures, this kaliri is set apart from others by its brilliant plumage and the lengths hunters will go to capture them.

331.description: Created to entertain children at the Darkmoon Faire, these magical balloons never lose their floatiness.

332.description: A magical wonder, these balloons will never deflate and are traditionally created in batches of ninety-nine.

341.description: These magical lanterns are acquired at the Lunar Festival, which celebrates the defeat of the Burning Legion by the free races of Azeroth.

374.description: Offspring of the black sheep, the black lamb is only found in the forests of Elwynn.

378.description: When you have two rabbits, you'll often soon have three.

379.description: Most people do not know the difference between a squirrel and a chipmunk. Most don't care.

385.description: It seems that mice are completely incapable of resisting cheese even in the face of imprisonment, injury, or death.

389.description: The tiny harvester collects weeds and small grains that the larger reapers may have missed.

397.description: Skunks are known as solitary creatures for reasons which are hopefully obvious.

398.description: While many people believe black cats to be bad luck, black rats are held in higher esteem.

440.description: The thick snow near Dun Morogh acts as camouflage for snow cubs learning to hunt.

447.description: Pay attention to deer crossings. Even a fawn will total a goblin trike.

452.description: According to the tales of the night elves, the first red-tailed chipmunk was colored so after the theft and consumption of a sacred apple.

507.description: Many owls nest high in the stone structures of Darnassus, hunting any pests that enter the night elves' city.

459.description: After centuries of domestication, these furry critters inhabit nearly every human nation in the Eastern Kingdoms.

646.description: Tends to avoid crossing roads, regardless of motivations.

847.description: Many believe (incorrectly) that goldfish have no memories. Trainers who have worked with them know this is clearly not the case and have the bruises to prove it.

849.description: A beautiful kite brought to life by the scribes of Pandaria.

850.description: Who knew scribes could make kites?

1161.description: You better believe he knows what time it is.

1212.description: Even at this size, these raptors can eviscerate an entire cow in less than 10 seconds.

1213.description: These adorable beasts are both cuddly and huggable, provided you do not enjoy having a face.

1320.description: This handsome little robot is the spitting image of his "Dad", Blingtron 4000.  As a Blingtron's generosity circuits don't mature until they have been built to maximum specification, you shouldn't expect any free handouts from him.

1386.description: The dark wings will cloud and consume the minds of the weak, because they are just so adorable!

1538.description: The deep blue Umbrafen would later become home to a tribe of Broken.

1687.description: Who would leave such a cute shark behind? The Iron Horde truly has no soul.

1691.description: This young stalker was easily swayed from Sargeras' grasp by a handful of Magical Mini-Treats.

1706.description: This little guy has had a rough start at life, be sure to take good care of him.

1717.description: What was once a great enemy is now an adorable friend!

1727.description: Why is it called a nursery spider? Does it prefer to lurk in nurseries? Why would it do that? What does it do there? Oh, dear! Someone check on the kids!

1753.description: When a helsquid has devoured most of the food in any area, it can return to its polyp form and begin life anew.

1890.description: His tiny legs make him more aerodynamic.

1921.description: A wyrmlings temperment hinges primarily on how long its been since its fed on mana. Remember to feed your pets.

1922.description: It's a bird! It's a cat! It's... biting me...

1934.description: Younger brother to Anax.  Big brother to Cenax and Denax.

2086.description: Some say it's the pup of Riplimb and Rageface, others say 'I don't want to think about that.'

2087.description: A rarely-seen cinderweb species known for devouring her mate's legs and laying eggs in his still-twitching body, and a lovely purple color.

2088.description: Five things he can never do without: surging, surging, surging, surging, surging.

2114.description: Who makes them? How do they get there? No one knows, except maybe Greatfather Winter.

2143.description: Tottle's one wish is to explore the world at your side!

2188.description: Poda was just a small part of the larger business, always trying to live up to the standards of his older brother Coda.

2190.description: A newly hatched Cobra can be just as deadly as a fully grown one, if not more.

2538.description: Like many other species, you can get a rough guess of how large the raptor will be as a fully grown adult by the size of its largest claw.

2622.description: These dazzling hatchlings have a distinctive coat color that has been highly sought after by leatherworkers for generations.

2686.description: When the sun shines on its shell just right, the light scatters in a thousand different directions.

2698.description: Even with its softer juvenile shell, a young prismatic spireshell still glitters like a diamond.

2713.description: A rare snooter, and hard to find, it's known for burrowing itself deep under wet foliage to nest.

2716.description: As handy as this invention is, it was also programmed to absolutely despise hand puns.

2776.description: Rikki has a talent for sneaking in and out of all manner of small spaces, if bribed properly with figs.

2779.description: Even the smallest creatures in the Shadowlands rely on anima to survive.

2780.description: Daisy moves at a very leisurely pace, and will happily accept a ride on your shoulders.

2798.description: In Maldraxxus, plague has a strange habit of finding its way back to you.

2878.description: If you received points for causing mischief while teleporting around as a tiny adorable vulpin, Renny would be on top of the leaderboard.

2892.description: Lightspawn can always be found on the battlefields where light touches, no matter what form it takes.

2908.description: Despite the adorable name, the chirp is more of a horrible, spine-tingling shriek.

2909.description: These ferocious flying creatures scrape their beaks against hard surfaces to sharpen them and intimidate foes.

2911.description: Much like how a squid can squirt ink to escape in the water, a glitterwing can shake the dust off of its wings and similarly vanish.

2914.description: When a full moon is visible, streaks of hair on the dreamfoal's mane start to shimmer and glow like shooting stars.

2920.description: There are more sharp pointy things on this species of gorm than there are on a Horde capital city.

2921.description: If you count the number of times its wings beat per minute, you can calculate how long it will be until this little terror will sting you.

2925.description: A group of teroclaws is known as a fleece.

2928.description: A glimmerfly can load up nearly fifty percent of its weight as pollen and still retain full agility while flying.

2953.description: One of Plague Deviser Marileth's first creations, Shy Melvin was too timid for the demands placed on slimes by the House of Plagues.

3008.description: No longer lost, it's now considering a name change.

3009.description: Roosting in the grounds of Castle Nathria, The Count did not foresee falling into an eternal stone slumber.

3013.description: What vile subtance is jiggling around inside of this creature?

3022.description: These critters are capable of holding a tremendous amount of food in their cheeks for easy transportation between hiding spaces.

3039.description: Tiny flakes of skin seem to perpetually fall off of this horrible creature, leaving behind a trail and a very distinct, foul odor.

3046.description: Despite being decrepit and undead, geists move with exceptional speed and agility.

3053.description: A strange whelp hatched on Netherwing Ledge, it is thought to be blessed by the waning lunar energies of Shadowmoon Valley.

3175.description: Hatch-queen of the baby murlocs, Murkastrasza spent many years battling her bitter rival, Deathy.

3177.description: A drakonid hatchling is a curious sight, but now is the time for curious things.

3244.description: Fooled aeons ago by the clever loa of death into a bargain of unceasing service, this tiny ancient being carries out his duties eternally red with rage.

3248.description: Ichabod began his existence as a prototype for the fearsome harvest golems terrorizing the farmers of Westfall, but a little gnomish ingenuity has since made him far less likely to attack your knees.

3252.description: Ancient Gorian blood runs through Garrlok's veins. As far as anyone knows, only his diminutive stature keeps his imperial ambitions in check.

3316.description: Who's the cutest little monster? You are!

3319.description: Soon after you put down this slyvern's decay-twisted mother, you learned the hard way both how it got its name and why Zon'Wogi asked you to care for it.

3321.description: There is no fury quite like that of a mother Blackfeather defending her nest.

3348.description: Raindrops whip around this creature with frightening speed, ripping and tearing anything that touches it. Experts say the best way to avoid injury is to give it a treat and some snuggles.

3580.description: Also known as the Lord of Lies, Baa'lial is a master of deceit.

4265.description: Feel the chill nipping at your toes! A menace of Azeroth, now in festive blue and travel-size!

4266.description: Though this little one's flight training has yet to be completed, their playfulness and enthusiasm are already fully grown.

4694.description: Previous owners of the crate have reported the disappearance of other pets from their collection.

4311.description: When she grows up, Mitzy wants to guide Greatfather Winter's sleigh just like Metzen, her famous dad. Until then, she's more than happy to come with you on your adventures.

4811.description: Wherever it goes, it leaves behind a soft glow that stirs hope in even the darkest places

4812.description: It glides through the air with shadowy wings and a trail of eerie whispers.
